title: fix(types): the stray-groupBy kanban refusal no longer denies the validation that emits it (objectui#9653)
body:
Fixes #9653
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Two false sentences in `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`, one fix window. What the schema refuses does not change.

**1. `KanbanStrayGroupByRefusal`'s message (runtime-visible, both channels).** It said a view carrying `groupBy` "never came through the validated path". A few clauses later the same message said the key "rode this object's `.passthrough()`" into `ListView` and changed the board. The first clause is deleted. The tail now says what happened and why the key is refused now:

```text
... and refuses `groupBy` by name. Write `groupByField` (or the deprecated `groupField`, which folds onto it). This package, by contrast, accepted the key green until this refusal: it passed `safeValidateSchema` in either nesting, kept by this object's `.passthrough()` or by the untyped legacy `options` bag, and reached `ListView`'s kanban branch, where it OVERRODE the lane that branch had already resolved from `groupByField` — the board grouped by the stray key, and nothing said so. That branch now drops the key, so it is refused here instead of being kept and then ignored.
```

The lead sentence (`Unrecognized key(s) on this kanban configuration: ...` / `Did you mean groupBy → groupByField?`), the key, both paths and both codes are byte-identical in behaviour. The old tail said the key "rode this object's `.passthrough()`". The new one also names the second channel, because on `options.kanban` the key was kept by the `z.record(z.string(), z.any())` bag, not by a passthrough.

**2. `checkNamedViewCalendarAliases`' docblock (seat 3's fold-in, comment 5732909013).** "Every alias refusal this module declares stops at `listViews`" was false under either reading of "stops at", because the function it documents refuses `listViews.KEY.calendar.dateField`. The sentence now says that no alias refusal reached inside `listViews` until this check, that this check is the only door in, and that it judges only the two calendar spellings, at both nestings. The paragraph's kanban-twin sentence now says that no pin re-derives that silence (AGENTS.md #9).

## Premise, measured before writing

- **The clause is false for this package's validator.** A throwaway probe ran in a detached worktree at `91facaef`, the parent of `704e6959` (PR objectui#9236, the commit that added the refusal), through `safeValidateSchema` and a real `ListView` mount with a registry spy. It gave **7/7** as predicted. `kanban.groupBy` passed and was KEPT (`data.kanban.groupBy`), and so was `options.kanban.groupBy` (`data.options.kanban.groupBy`). LIT CONTROL: the same door refused a wrong-typed `kanban.groupByField`, so it does judge the block. The rendered `object-kanban` node carried `groupBy: LANE_FROM_STRAY_GROUPBY` in **both** nestings, with `groupByField: LANE_FROM_CANONICAL` present. RENDER CONTROL: the canonical key alone resolved the canonical lane.
- **What the clause may have meant is true of the protocol.** On the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0, `ListViewSchema` refuses `kanban.groupBy` (`unrecognized_keys` at `kanban`) and refuses `options` outright. Its controls: a canonical view is ACCEPTED, and a bogus top-level key is refused. The new text keeps the protocol's refusal and drops the inference.
- **Reach of every `aliasKeyRefusal()` family at HEAD `8b1f0661`** (throwaway probe through `safeValidateSchema`, each control first): the kanban `groupBy` arm refuses on `list-view` `kanban` and `options.kanban`, and a named view carrying it is **ACCEPTED** in both nestings. The calendar block arms refuse on `list-view` `calendar` and `options.calendar`, **and** on `listViews.v1.calendar.dateField`, `…endField` and `listViews.v1.options.calendar.dateField` (`custom`, via this check). A flat `listViews.v1.dateField` is ACCEPTED. The node and container arms refuse on `object-calendar` only.
- **Third-instance search** (the card's ask): `git grep -n -i 'validated path\|never came through'` over the tree finds no third instance in `packages/types/src/zod/**`. Two siblings outside this surface are under Acceptance notes.
- **Still unreleased.** `.changeset/8365-stray-kanban-groupby-refused.md` is present at base `8b1f0661`. The npm `@object-ui/types@17.6.0` tarball has `aliasKeyRefusal` 0 and the old clause 0, while its lit controls fire (`safeValidateSchema` 3 files, `ListViewSchema` 7, `Kanban-specific configuration` 1).
- **Hot file clear.** PR objectui#9540 was merged on 2026-09-20. No open PR's file list includes `objectql.zod.ts`: all 29 open PRs were read (a short page, so the list is complete).

## Tests, at `ee1f2a7a` (final commit), from the repo root under the verify lock

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (all three tsconfigs) passed, run with `&&`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes the new pin: 1 hit, out of 215 `src/__tests__` files.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/ packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.strayGroupByRefused-8365.test.tsx packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.calendarAliasRefused-8355.test.tsx packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.strayGroupByLane-9242.test.tsx` → `Test Files 218 passed (218)`, `Tests 4959 passed (4959)`.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes` OK · `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)` · `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` ✅ · `pnpm check:changeset-claims` passes self-contradiction. It flags 20 pending changesets that name `objectql.zod.ts`. Each was read, and none describes the edited message or docblock sentence. · `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` ✅ · `pnpm type-check:coverage` ✅.
- `@object-ui/types` build (`tsc && vite build && check-dist-completeness`): the new message is in `dist/zod/objectql.zod.js` and `dist/zod/index.zod.js`. The old clause appears 0 times, and the lit control (the lead sentence) is present in both files. The docblock is also emitted as a comment into the built JS, so the changeset names it too.
- Narrowed lint, a measurement and not a skip. ① Population: `eslint.config.js` covers both changed TS files (not ignored; 116 and 118 rules resolved). ② `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` read 2 files: 0 errors, 1 warning, a pre-existing `no-explicit-any` in the untouched `options` check. ③ Invariance: the config sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

## Pin and ablation

New file `packages/types/src/__tests__/kanban-stray-group-by-refusal-text-9653.test.ts`, 5 tests across both channels:
- NEGATIVE: no clause matches "never came / went / passed through the validated path / a validator".
- LIT CONTROL on the true clause: the message still names `.passthrough()`.
- MATCHER CONTROL: the pattern fires on the retired clause.

It pins content, not sentences. `code` and `path` are pinned already by the objectui#8365 tests.

Ablation, predicted first, through `ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP mode, anchor hit ×1, blob moved) with a bash `trap` belt:
- **Leg 0** (HEAD `e9fce805`): 5/5 green.
- **Leg A** (retired text restored; on disk the old phrase is ×1 and the new ×0): both NEGATIVE red, both LIT green, MATCHER green (2 failed, 3 passed).
- **Leg B** (history clause dropped; on disk ×0 and ×0): both NEGATIVE green, both LIT red, MATCHER green (2 failed, 3 passed).
- **Restore proven:** blob `00d6d77f` equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` is empty, and `git status` is clean.

## Acceptance notes

- **Text-pin proportionality.** The dispatch asked for a text pin. The dev contract forbids pinning refusal prose unless a consumer parses it. The pin therefore asserts only a banned claim and a named mechanism. The docblock sentence is not pinned: it is a comment with no runtime reader, and the `listViews` search the sentence names re-derives it.
- **Sibling of the same wrong model, observed, not edited.** The calendar stem (`CALENDAR_DATE_ALIAS_STEM`, objectui#8355's text) says the keys "rode a `.passthrough()` straight through `safeValidateSchema`". On the `options.calendar` channel they were kept by the `z.any()` record, not by a passthrough. This is about mechanism only; the stem's validation claim is true. Not filed. Carrier: none.
- **Out of surface, class a (for the seat to file).** Two claims say the objectui#8365 refusal "already covers both routes" or that what remains is "a stored document that never passed through a validator": `.changeset/9242-stray-kanban-groupby-lane-second-route.md` (pending, so it publishes verbatim into the CHANGELOG), and the kanban-branch comment in `generateViewSchema` in `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` (the paragraph beginning "The contract half is NOT here"). The reach probe row `object-view listViews.v1.kanban.groupBy → ACCEPTED` falsifies both, with `listViews.v1.calendar.dateField → REFUSED` as the lit control on the same door. Neither file was touched: they are outside this claim's file surface. Open PR objectui#10283 touches `ObjectView.tsx`.
